execution.ref: VALIDATOR-17, branch claude/validator-17-tuning-set. Canonical: tuning, confirmation, validator and Graphite suites passed; the results are recorded in the PR.
execution.description: Battery's sealed tuning set is registered, reserved and protected, with operator tools to export the hidden pool as a prior, recall, solve, predict and score it, all host-only.

expected: A tuning set could reuse the confirmation-set registry and EV5's host-only solve pattern unchanged.
observed: It could. Sealing it in the testnet deployment lets EV5 and the Graphite confirmation set be checked by regeneration; the rotating pool and the practice decision set must be supplied as private priors, and the seal fails closed until they are.
keep: Give every hidden set one job: rotating pool for operation, tuning set for development, confirmation set once.
Keep per-case rows of the tuning set so weightings re-score without retraining.
change: Name a new sealed set in Graphite's protected markers in the same change that registers it.
protocol_elements: every Challenge's score development runs on a sealed tuning set no agent or miner sees
